info.title: Ikon SEO
info.description: Audits, plans, measures, creates, improves and safely approves SEO-focused WordPress pages.

get.summary: Read the active website identity, schema policy and publishing rules before writing

post.summary: Read the active website strategy and operating mode; save an approved strategy update only when save is true
Read workflow state; create mode-based workflows, update or approve tasks, run read-only automation and generate briefings
Read executive portfolio analytics and govern internal risks
post.description: Consolidates read-only managed-site snapshots, approval queues, risk records, capacity forecasts and client-safe preview data. It cannot publish or change a managed website.

get.summary: Find existing pages before creating content

post.summary: Create a page or separate improvement draft

get.summary: Read page content, SEO, schema and quality data

patch.summary: Update an Ikon SEO managed draft

get.summary: Read URL discovery, sitemap parity, internal-link graph, redirect evidence and PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals findings

post.summary: Read and manage quota-aware Google index evidence, canonical disagreements, inspection queues and production health checks
Read stored competitor and content intelligence; optionally store current competitor observations or create a page-level content brief
Read imported authority and off-site evidence; optionally store approved backlink or competitor-link observations
Read or refresh the unified operating plan, manage recommendation states, capture baselines, measure outcomes and create recovery checkpoints
Run non-destructive staging checks and approve an evidence-locked certification handoff
post.description: No command publishes, installs or changes live content. Run preparation uses draft scope; approval requires approve scope and production environments are blocked.

post.summary: Synchronise approval-first agency governance policies and local decisions
post.description: Policies are delivered as proposals only. A local WordPress administrator must accept a proposal before activation. No command publishes or changes public content.

post.summary: Read local growth readiness; refresh approved evidence, synchronize review and conversion workflows, and store competitor-prominence observations without changing public profiles
Read, run and apply review-first website discovery and strategy proposals
Read and save fact-level confirmations, corrected values, rejections and conflict resolutions without changing live pages
Read or activate the approval-first workflow, safe audit batch and Operating Plan after discovery review
Read, rebuild and review a unified evidence-based opportunity queue; optionally import approved Semrush, Ahrefs or licensed-provider keyword evidence
Convert planned opportunities into evidence-locked briefs, approve or reject briefs, create separate drafts, run quality gates and mark drafts ready for human review
Assign controlled drafts, manage review rounds and comments, verify sources and claims, compare revisions, record final sign-off and keep publishing separate
Create immutable release candidates from signed-off drafts, run preflight checks, record readiness approval, detect manual publication and perform read-only post-launch verification
post.description: Creates release candidates and verification records but never publishes, schedules, merges, redirects, deletes or changes indexability. Commands mark_ready, record_manual_publication, complete_monitoring, block and unblock require the approve key scope. Preparation and read-only verification commands require draft scope.

post.summary: Create and monitor baseline-versus-post-launch impact studies using stored first-party evidence, comparison pages and human-reviewed outcome decisions
post.description: No command changes a public page. Assessment, acknowledgement and blocking decisions require the approve key scope; study creation, evidence capture and confounder recording require draft scope. Outcomes describe association and do not assert causation.

post.summary: Aggregate anonymised, acknowledged impact evidence into context-bounded pattern candidates and record human validation decisions
post.description: No pattern is automatically applied. Validation, limited-use, rejection, retirement and restoration decisions require the approve scope. Refresh and anonymised evidence import require draft scope.

post.summary: Manage agency service plans, capacity, work delivery and approval-gated client reports
post.description: Creates operational records and client-report drafts only. Report delivery is manual and no command publishes content, sends client communication or changes a managed website.

post.summary: Run release integrity and compatibility checks, create credential-free recovery archives, preview same-version restores and repair scheduled events
post.description: Configuration restore, scheduler repair and cleanup require the approve key scope. No command publishes or edits WordPress content, transmits diagnostics, or performs an automatic rollback.

post.summary: Read entitlement status, register signed releases, prepare approval-gated deployment plans and verify manually installed updates
post.description: No command downloads, installs, activates, deactivates or rolls back plugin code. Approval, entitlement and manual-deployment decisions require the approve key scope.

post.summary: Create support contracts, certify signed releases and govern manual rollout waves
post.description: No command downloads, installs, rolls back or publishes anything. Contract, certification and rollout approvals require the approve key scope.

event_ref.description: An internal reference that is hashed before storage.

metadata.description: Optional non-identifying metadata. Do not include names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses or message content.

save.description: Leave false to read strategy. Set true only after an approved strategy update.

map_query.description: Verified address or place query for the native Elementor map widget.

profile_id.description: Current profile_id returned by GET /profile. Prevents cross-client writes.

LocalPage.description: Required for schema.page_type=location. Verified locations and service areas use different safety policies.

show_address.description: Must be false for service-area pages.

emit_location_entity.description: Must be false for service-area pages.

SchemaConfig.description: Allow-listed schema configuration. FAQ rich results are retired; semantic FAQ markup is optional.

business_entity.description: Optional explicit entity node. Its type is always taken from the active Website Profile.

accounting_service.description: v0.2 compatibility only; rejected outside an AccountingService profile.

claim_token.description: One-time token returned by the claim action. It expires after one hour.

LocalGrowthSync.description: Call with command read to inspect the Local Growth System. Refresh and synchronization commands remain read-only toward public profiles. Review workflow updates and prominence observations store planning evidence only.

WorkspaceSync.description: Call with an empty object to resume project context. Optionally include one event or one status update, then receive the refreshed project state.

AuthoritySync.description: Call with an empty object to read imported authority evidence. Optionally store approved link observations. Imported provider metrics remain labelled evidence and are never converted into a proprietary authority score.

competitor_domain.description: Required when relationship is competitor_backlink unless it can be inferred from every target URL.

source_strength.description: Optional provider metric retained without cross-provider normalization.

CompetitorContentSync.description: Call with an empty object to read the current competitor and content intelligence state. Optionally store up to 50 current competitor observations and/or create one page-level brief. Never copy competitor content or treat competitor claims as facts about the connected business.

snapshot_id.description: Optional. The newest snapshot is used when omitted.

url.description: Must be on the current WordPress website.

GBPDraft.description: Stages content locally. It cannot send, publish or reply until a WordPress administrator approves the exact draft.

generated_at.description: Optimistic-lock value from the current discovery report.

OpportunityEngineSync.description: Read-only analysis. This action cannot publish, redirect, delete, noindex or change canonicals.

evidence_hash.description: Use the exact current brief evidence hash for approval and draft creation.

PublishingReadinessSync.description: Approval-gated publishing governance. No command publishes or changes a public page. Approval decisions require the approve connection-key scope.

SearchImpactSync.description: Measures association between a manual publication and later stored evidence. It does not prove causation, invent targets or change public content. Assessment and human acknowledgement require the approve connection-key scope.

PatternLibrarySync.description: Builds context-bounded advisory patterns from anonymised acknowledged evidence. It never applies a pattern, changes public content or makes a causal or universal claim.
